environment.description: Same service deployed in namespace 'data-plane' on GKE cluster with Istio 1.19 mesh. Sidecar injection enabled (istio-proxy container present). An AuthorizationPolicy resource is applied at mesh level with a 'DENY' action matching source namespaces not in an explicit allow-list. The policy uses a workload selector matching app label 'status-svc' and specifies: when source.namespace is NOT in ['data-plane', 'istio-system'], deny all HTTP methods on paths matching '/api/*'. Additionally, a PeerAuthentication policy in the namespace enforces STRICT mTLS mode, meaning only mesh-enrolled workloads with valid SPIFFE identities can establish connections. The Envoy sidecar terminates TLS before traffic reaches the application container on localhost:3000. Note: the AuthorizationPolicy does NOT cover the /metrics or /healthz paths as those are excluded for Prometheus scraping from the 'monitoring' namespace.
